summary: Serialize ordinary object keys in ECMAScript own-enumerable string-key order when no replacer PropertyList is active.

target.notes: Reuse JsObject.Keys for the object-key list: canonical array-index keys ascending, then other string keys in creation order; Symbol keys are excluded.

semantics.key_source: same own enumerable string-key ordering contract as JsObject.Keys
semantics.string_order: remaining strings in property creation order
semantics.snapshot: the key list for an object is established when that object's serialization starts

caveats: C# Dictionary enumeration or reflection metadata order is not the semantic contract.
Reuse object.keys ordering responsibility instead of defining a competing generic property-order helper.

tests.name: added key after snapshot is not visited
tests.expected_behavior: prints {"a":1,"b":2}; c was added after the key list was captured
